description: This file defines the PublisherUtilities class, providing utility static methods for handling titles and update logic within the Confluence publishing context in the Daux documentation generator.

classes.name: PublisherUtilities
classes.description: Utility class for handling title formatting and update checks during Confluence publication in the Daux documentation tool.

methods.name: niceTitle
methods.description: Converts a filename or URL title into a human-readable title, replacing 'index.html' with 'Homepage' and stripping other HTML suffixes.

methods.name: shouldUpdate
methods.description: Determines whether an existing published page needs to be updated based on content similarity, considering a threshold and optional debug file logging.
